L26n1211.name: Miles unit to ap
L26n1211.description: Negative pole fires on 'miles' after a number and on word stems; pushes toward 'ap' tokens.

L26n1244.name: Word-start intr- and inter- prefixes
L26n1244.description: Fires on word-start fragments like 'intr-' and 'inter-' (intranet, intersex); pushes toward 'prefix' and 'notation'.

L26n1968.name: Mid-word fragments, writes union
L26n1968.description: Fires on mid-word fragments (inc-, chron-, Franc-, morph-); pushes toward 'union' tokens.

L25n1019.name: Options after setup words
L25n1019.description: Reads verbs and prepositions that set up an object (prevent, Request, into, of); pushes toward 'options'.

L25n409.name: Mojibake reads, code closers
L25n409.description: Reads mojibake and accented-letter fragments in garbled text; pushes toward closing quotes and parentheses.

L26n2666.name: Name fragments, DNA writes
L26n2666.description: Reads word-start fragments of names and technical terms (beta-arr-, nanop-, Beg-); pushes toward 'DNA' and 'password'.

L26n240.name: Opening brackets, scattered nouns
L26n240.description: Reads opening brackets and quotes before a gloss or list item; pushes toward scattered nouns (board, top, width).
